mapper.select: SELECT um.*, s.school_name as school_name_alias, g.grade_name as grade_name_alias FROM user_message um LEFT JOIN s_schools s ON um.school_id = s.school_id LEFT JOIN s_grades g ON um.grade_id = g.grade_id WHERE um.message_user_id = #{messageUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_message ( message_user_id, message_user_name, message_user_age, message_user_sex, message_user_address, height, weight, chest, waist, hip, shoulder, school_id, grade_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{messageUserId}, #{messageUserName}, #{messageUserAge}, #{messageUserSex}, #{messageUserAddress}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{chest}, #{waist}, #{hip}, #{shoulder}, #{schoolId}, #{gradeId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_message SET message_user_name = #{messageUserName}, message_user_age = #{messageUserAge}, message_user_sex = #{messageUserSex}, message_user_address = #{messageUserAddress}, height = #{height}, weight = #{weight}, chest = #{chest}, waist = #{waist}, hip = #{hip}, shoulder = #{shoulder}, school_id = #{schoolId}, grade_id = #{gradeId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
